final:
shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 42) == []
  ex shuffled([1], 0) == [1]
  var res = copy xs
  var state = (seed % 2147483646) + 1
  var i = res.len() - 1
  while i > 0
    state = (state * 48271) % 2147483647
    let j = state % (i + 1)
    let tmp = res[i]
    res[i] = res[j]
    res[j] = tmp
    i -= 1
  res
